system.description:
You have stolen information, tactics and techniques from careless hidden Cloud shinobi that gloat of their impregnable defenses.

When you cast a Genwa Hijutsu, gain a rank of Mastery against jutsu with a nature release keyword, until the start of your next turn.

Once per turn, when you cast a Genwa Hijutsu, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC until the start of your next turn. This increases to +2 at 11th level.

Jutsu you cast with the Sensory keyword that you benefit from gain the following effect; For the duration, you become aware if another Sensory effect is within 60 feet of you (or the range of the cast Sensory jutsu, whichever is greater)
